@graph.name: Invisalign in Denver, CO
@graph.description: Get a straighter smile with Invisalign in Denver, CO. Virtually invisible clear aligners designed for comfort, convenience, and effective teeth straightening.

acceptedAnswer.text: Invisalign uses custom-made clear aligners that gradually shift your teeth into position. You switch to a new set every 1–2 weeks.
Most patients experience only mild pressure for a day or two when switching to a new aligner tray.

mainEntity.name: How long does Invisalign treatment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Treatment ranges from 6–18 months depending on your alignment needs.

mainEntity.name: Can I eat and drink with Invisalign?

acceptedAnswer.text: You must remove aligners before eating or drinking anything other than water. This keeps them clean and damage-free.

mainEntity.name: How often should I wear Invisalign aligners?

acceptedAnswer.text: For best results, wear them 20–22 hours per day.

mainEntity.name: Is Invisalign more expensive than braces?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary based on your case, but Invisalign is often comparable to traditional braces. Flexible financing is available.
